Add a standalone helper function in src/config/mod.rs that expands tilde to HOME environment variable.

   - Expands bare '~' to HOME environment variable

   - Paths without tilde (unchanged)
   - '~/'' prefix (expands to HOME)
   - Bare '~' (expands to HOME)
   - Missing HOME (returns path unchanged)

## Acceptance criteria
- Helper function exists with proper error handling
- No unwrap/expect in non-test code
- Unit tests cover all cases
- cargo clippy clean
- No integration with config loading yet (just the helper)"
